name: Cube 'n Roll Italian Open 2010
information: Registration closed. Registration fee: 4 euro, including the first events, for each additional events you will pay 1 euro. If you will do 8 or more events, you will pay 12€ in each case. The venue is easy to reach by subway, there will be also a free shuttle from the Hotel to the Venue. Sunday it will be possible to eat in a place near the venue, all the competitors will have a big discount.
